findings.effect: The expectation does not check that the agent asked a question. A reply that calls get_journey and makes no proposal passes even if it incorrectly refuses removal or merely describes the section.
findings.reason: The new asks-first case only requires get_journey and forbids proposals, so a refusal or description can pass without the required clarifying question.

findings.effect: When a proposal is expected but missing, the maxReplyWords check falls back to the full assistantText rather than the text after the card. This adds a misleading second reply_words failure that grades a different text.
findings.reason: maxReplyWords explicitly checks the full reply when no proposal is present, so the fallback and an independent reply_words failure follow its documented contract.
